# Princeton WordNet 3.0

The English definitions in the offline dictionary are derived from Princeton
WordNet Release 3.0. The source archive and full license are included under
`static/data/wordnet/`.

Source archive: NLTK data distribution of WordNet 3.0,
https://github.com/nltk/nltk_data/blob/gh-pages/packages/corpora/wordnet.zip

Bundled archive SHA-256:
`CBDA5EA6EEF7F36A97A43D4A75F85E07FCCBB4F23657D27B4CCBC93E2646AB59`

The WordNet license permits redistribution and modification provided its
copyright notice and license terms are preserved. The license is included in
the source archive and at `static/data/wordnet/LICENSE`.
